summary.text: Bob Harb is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 20 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.
Harb is an attorney, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Robert Harb was born in Haverhill, Massachusetts.

He earned a B.A. from the University of Notre Dame in 1972, an LL.M. from Boston University in 1975, and a J.D. from Boston University in 1976, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
Harb has served as the president of the Plaistow Exchange Club, the director of the Plaistow YMCA, and the president of the New England Morgan Horse Association, Inc.
Ballotpedia lists Harb's tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2018.
